notes.title: I Frog-ot Winter Update!
notes.content:
[h1]❄Merry Christmas!❄[/h1]

This year, Santa wanted to bring you a Frog-ot update! Complete with bug fixes, a winter re-skin, and new lore! I know I told many of you I was never planning on revisiting this game but, peer pressure is a wonderful motivator lol. This will probably be the final patch this game gets. I know it’s not a perfect game, and it never will be, but it was the first video game I ever made! I learned how to use unity and code along the way, and I have no intention on ever making this polished and perfect. Instead, I am using my new found love for game making to work on a sequel (Something that WILL be polished and perfect!) So please, until I can give you more, enjoy the following new features :)



[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] A mouse sensitivity slider in the main game
[*] No more motion blur
[*] Photosensitivity warning
[*] Overall optimization (to help with crashing)
[*] No more yeeting horror house objects (rip)
[*] Horror house objects easier to find
[*] Tried to look into the mysterious stairs glitch. Could not recreate, but I tried to fix colliders anyway. PLEASE let me know if anyone still experiences this!
[/list]

[h2]New Content/Lore (for those who have already played the game)[/h2]
[list]
[*] New paintings 
[*] New notes
[*] New super secret cutscene after disobedient ending
[*] Winter re-skin (very important, much lore)
[/list]



While I would love to do more with the game, I really do want to spend my energy towards working on the new game. It has already been in production for almost a year now, and I would be lucky to finish it by 2026 (tough to make games when I have like, a regular job too lmao). So! Until then, please feel free to follow my Instagram page (you can get to it from the main menu now!) where you can expect periodic updates on the new game, and can be the first to see any secrets or Easter eggs teased between posts!



Until next time, 

Krabby Daddy ✌
